summary: A processor design made by an alliance of Apple, IBM and Motorola to challenge Intel. It ran Macs from 1994 to 2006 and the GameCube, Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3.

events.note: Apple, IBM and Motorola form the alliance.

events.label: Apple leaves
events.note: Apple moves the Mac to Intel.

note: Left the PC after Apple moved to Intel in 2006; it lives on in embedded systems and as the Power ISA.
